news.headline: Protego Ventures closes debut $125 million fund for Israeli defense tech
news.summary: Protego Ventures, Israel's first dedicated defense tech VC, has closed its debut fund at $125 million. The firm aims to back Israeli startups tackling defense and national security challenges in an increasingly militarized region.

news.headline: Crypto ETFs Surge as Bitcoin Funds Add $2.95 Billion in 30 Days
news.summary: Bitcoin ETFs are on a roll: eight consecutive days of inflows as the market bounces back from recent selling pressure. The surge reflects renewed investor appetite, with funds pulling in significant capital over the past month.

educational.title: What Actually Happens When You Buy a Stock
points: You're buying a tiny slice of real ownership in a company, not a lottery ticket
Your broker matches your order with a seller through an exchange in milliseconds
Stock price moves on collective belief about future profits, not just today's news
You make money two ways: the price rising, or dividends paid out over time
Owning one share still makes you a part-owner, with voting rights and all
